findings.explanation: With versioning enabled and no lifecycle_rule, every prior version of every state object is retained forever. Detected deterministically by holden policy HLD_GCP_339.
findings.remediation: Add a lifecycle_rule to expire or downgrade storage class of noncurrent versions after N days.
findings.title: GCS state bucket has no lifecycle rule

findings.remediation: Add a lifecycle_rule to expire old log objects.
findings.suppression_reason: User decision (2026-08-02): accepted risk, example log bucket — suppressed via # holden:ignore:HLD_GCP_339.

findings.explanation: main.tf is a placeholder comment only; there is no terraform { required_providers {...} } block anywhere in the root module, even though it uses both the google and local providers. Consumers get no signal about which provider versions this module was tested against, unlike example/examplea/terraform.tf which pins google 7.30.0 and local 2.8.0 exactly. Deterministic policies that check required_providers attributes cannot fire here because the block itself is absent, not malformed.
findings.remediation: Add a terraform { required_providers { google = { source = "hashicorp/google", version = ">= 7.0" }, local = { source = "hashicorp/local", version = ">= 2.0" } }, required_version = ">=1.5.0" } block to the module root.
findings.title: Root module declares no required_providers / required_version constraint

findings.explanation: The Usage example sets common_tags = var.common_tags, but that variable was removed in commit f153c71 (replaced by provider default_labels). It also sets kms_key = "pike", which fails the module's own kms_key validation regex (^projects/.+/locations/.+/keyRings/.+/cryptoKeys/.+$), and omits the two required variables (location, project_id) entirely. A user copy-pasting this example gets an immediate error.
findings.fix:
module "statebucket" {
  source     = "JamesWoolfenden/statebucket/gcp"
  version    = "0.3.22"
  location   = "europe-west2"
  project_id = "my-project"
  kms_key    = "projects/my-project/locations/europe-west2/keyRings/my-ring/cryptoKeys/my-key"
}
findings.remediation: Update the README example to drop common_tags, use a full KMS resource ID for kms_key, and include location and project_id.
findings.title: README usage example is stale and will not plan as written
